component.name: bunk-gui
component.summary: Terminal for running coding agents side by side

description.p: bunk-gui is a GPU-rendered terminal built on the emulator core of the bunk multiplexer. Each tab is a workspace for one coding agent, with splits and scrollback.

ul.li: Tabs show which agent runs, its repository and branch, and whether it is working or waiting for you
Jump to the next tab that needs you, or switch tabs from the keyboard
Recognises Claude Code, Copilot CLI, Codex and other agent CLIs; more are added in the config file
Splits, scrollback, mouse selection and clipboard
Draws only changed rows and no frames while idle
